page.overview:
Who is Evil Saiyan?

This state lets the Saiyan generate a black and crimson red aura. It causes a noticeable increase in height and muscle mass, plus gives the Saiyan sterner and defined eyes. It also gives wilder hair reaching to the knees and a single forehead lock of hair.

Overall, the appearance is very similar to Super Saiyan 3, albeit with black hair typical of Saiyans in their base forms, and retaining their eyebrows.

Cumber in this state originally proved to be able to fight on par with Super Saiyan Blue Vegito and later Super Saiyan 4 Xeno Vegito, though later he was shown needing to utilize this state alongside Super Saiyan 3 to battle the likes of Top or Super Saiyan Blue Goku. This state also gives the user an Evil Aura with a variety of special abilities.

Cumber utilizes this state throughout the entirety of his appearance.
